Create soap smooth

make_soap.Rd

Creation of the soap smooth parameters from the effort table, needed for the GAM calucaltion in 'mgcv' function.

Usage

make_soap(effort_table)

Arguments

effort_table

dataframe. Effort table.

Value

list with 2 arguments: 'knots' and 'bound'

Examples

Effort <- pelascope::data_effort_with_sightings

make_soap(Effort)
